---
format: html
---

```{r}
withTags(
  card(
    class = "card text-white bg-primary mb-3",
    card_header(
      span("Course Logistics"),
      span(course_info[[params$course]][["course_no"]])
    ),
    card_image(file = sprintf("graphics/%s_header.png", course_info[[params$course]][["file_prefix"]]), width = "100%"),
    card_title(paste0("This course meets: ", course_info[[params$course]][["day_time"]], " in ", course_info[[params$course]][["location"]])),
    accordion(
      accordion_panel(
        "Description",
        course_info[[params$course]][["course_description"]]
      ),
      open = FALSE
    ),
    card_footer(
      span(if (!is.na(course_info[[params$course]][["prereqs"]])) paste0("Prerequisites: ", course_info[[params$course]][["prereqs"]]) else ""),
      span(layout_columns(p(course_info[[params$course]][["semester"]]), p(paste(course_info[[params$course]][["credits"]], "Credits"))))
    )
  )
)
```
